title: Sectionwise restriction from the constant ring sheaf to fixed scalars
statement: For a scheme W and commutative ring A, let constantModule W A send a module sheaf over the constant ring sheaf on the small etale site to the fixed-A module-valued sheaf obtained by restriction along the constant presheaf sheafification unit. Its underlying sections, restriction maps and maps of sheaves are unchanged. This is the existing AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.SystemProjection.constantModule functor, not the system projection theory, coefficient cocycle, compact-support operation or a theorem about them.

source.place: Tags 03CV and 03CY, restriction of scalars along the constant-presheaf sheafification unit. Existing constantModule construction in EtaleSystemProjectionData.lean:314.

proof.text: Restrict the module presheaf along the sheafification unit followed by forgetting commutativity. Its semilinear maps are linear over A because the source ring presheaf is constant. The underlying abelian sheaf is unchanged, so the reflected sheaf condition produces a fixed-A module-valued sheaf. Apply the same unchanged components to morphisms; functor identity and composition laws hold sectionwise. This is the already implemented constantModule body.
